# Test vectors

* `vectors.json` — known-good material generated by `tools/generate_vectors.py`
  from the Python implementation: canonical bytes, EventHashes, signatures,
  Merkle roots and proofs, integer and number formatting, Ed25519 edge cases.
  The TypeScript tests and the MQL5 self-test must reproduce it.
* `hostile.json` — malformed and adversarial inputs. Expected results are
  written by hand in `tools/generate_vectors.py`, not computed by a verifier.
  Both test suites must produce every one of them and never raise.
* `vcp-event-v1.2.schema.json` — a copy of the VCP v1.2 event schema from
  [veritaschain/vcp-spec](https://github.com/veritaschain/vcp-spec/blob/b23acb266f88df81d960d36d58fb64ceaa0dd5ed/spec/v1.2/vcp-event-v1.2.json)
  (tag `v1.2.0`, CC BY 4.0, maintained by VSO), used to check that the events in
  `vectors.json` are schema-valid.

All data is synthetic. The anchor proofs are placeholders, not real external anchors.
